L100: ## 【40†About】
L101: ## Committed to Quality Education
L102: When you’re exploring universities and online degree programs, accreditation is one of the most important things to look for. While it’s not mandatory for institutions to be accredited, it’s a strong signal that a school meets high standards for academic quality and integrity. Accreditation can also make a real difference when it comes to transferring credits, qualifying for financial aid, and even landing a job — many employers prefer or require degrees from accredited institutions.
L103: At University of Massachusetts Global, we’re proud to hold both institutional and professional accreditations. You can explore the full list of our current accreditations below.
L104: ### Institutional Accreditation
L105: 
L106: 【50†Image】
L107: 
L108: ## WASC Senior College and University Commission (WSCUC)
L109: 
L110: University of Massachusetts Global is institutionally accredited by the WASC Senior College and University Commission (WSCUC), 1080 Marina Village Parkway, Suite 500, Alameda, CA 94501; (510) 748-9001. Additional industry and programmatic accreditations apply to select degrees. 【51†See all programs†www.wscuc.org】.
L111: 
L112: ### Professional Accreditations
L113: #### California Commission on Teaching Credentialing
L114: 
L115: University of Massachusetts Global's School of Education is accredited by the California Commission on Teaching Credentialing (CTC). 【52†Learn More†www.ctc.ca.gov】
L116: 
L117: 【53†Image: AAQEP - Association for Advancing Quality in Educator Preparation】
L118: #### AAQEP - Association for Advancing Quality in Educator Preparation
L119: The University of Massachusetts Global is a member in good standing of the 【54†Association for Advancing Quality in Educator Preparation (AAQEP)†aaqep.org】, a national accrediting organization recognized by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation. The programs listed below have been awarded initial accreditation status with AAQEP through June 30, 2030.
L120: Accreditation acknowledges that a program prepares effective educators who continue to grow as professionals and has demonstrated the commitment and capacity to maintain quality.
L121: Initial Teacher Preparation: Programs that prepare individuals for their first professional teaching credential
L122: Advanced Educator Preparation: Programs that prepare already-licensed educators to qualify for additional credentials or that add to their professional capabilities
L123: P-12 Leader Preparation: Programs preparing individuals for credentials as building principals, district superintendents, and other educational leaders or administrators
L124: Specialized Professional Personnel Preparation: Programs that prepare personnel for roles for which a teaching credential may not be a prerequisite or that lead to no specific credential
L125: 【55†Image: cswe logo】
L126: #### Council on Social Work Education (CSWE)
L127: 
L128: University of Massachusetts Global's Bachelor of Arts of Social Work and Master in Social Work are accredited by the Council on Social Work Education’s (CSWE) Board of Accreditation (BOA).
L129: Accreditation of a baccalaureate or master’s social work program by the BOA indicates that it meets or exceeds standards of program quality evaluated through a peer review accreditation process. An accredited program has sufficient resources to meet its mission and goals and the BOA has verified that it demonstrates compliance with all sections of the Educational Policy and Accreditation Standards (EPAS).
L130: 
L131: Accreditation applies to all program options, which includes locations and delivery methods.
L132: Accreditation provides reasonable assurance about the quality of the program and the competence of students graduating from the program.
L133: 
L134: Review our program’s accreditation status in 【56†CSWE’s Directory of Accredited Programs†www.cswe.org】. For more information about social work accreditation, contact CSWE’s Department of Social Work Accreditation (accreditation@cswe.org).

L11: ## University of Maine at Presque Isle: Accreditation & Recognized Programs
L12: 
L13: The University of Maine at Presque Isle (UMPI) stands as a fully accredited institution, renowned for its high standards in education, with multiple programs receiving prestigious accreditations. Our commitment to quality education ensures students receive an exceptional learning experience, recognized both regionally and nationally.
L14: ### Why Accreditation Matters for Top Universities and Colleges in the US
L15: 
L16: Accreditation is a critical benchmark of educational quality, positioning UMPI among top universities in the US. Accreditation not only certifies the institution’s adherence to rigorous standards but also assures students of the validity and recognition of their degrees across the country.
L17: ### NECHE Accreditation: A Standard of Excellence
L18: 
L19: UMPI is accredited by the 【6†New England Commission of Higher Education (NECHE)†www.neche.org】, as part of the Commission’s accreditation of the University of Maine System, which maintains high standards for academic and institutional quality. NECHE’s recognition places UMPI among a select group of universities and colleges that meet the comprehensive criteria for educational excellence.
L20: Inquiries regarding the accreditation status by NECHE should be directed to the administrative staff of the institution. Individuals may also contact:
L21: 
L22: The New England Commission of Higher Education
L23: 3 Burlington Woods Drive, Suite 100, Burlington, MA 01803-4514
L24: (781) 425.7785
L25: e-mail: info@neche.org
L26: ### Accredited Programs at UMPI
L27: 
L28: UMPI’s programs are recognized by specialized accrediting agencies, enhancing their value and aligning with industry standards. Here are some of our top accredited programs:
L29:   * Teacher Education Programs – Accredited by the Maine Department of Education
L30:   * Medical Laboratory Technology Associate Degree – National Accrediting Agency for Clinical Laboratory Sciences (NAACLS)
L31:   * Social Work Program – Council of Social Work Education (CSWE)
L32:   * Athletic Training Education Program – Commission on Accreditation of Athletic Training Education (CAATE)
L33:   * Physical Therapist Assistant Program – Commission on Accreditation in Physical Therapy Education (CAPTE)
L34: Each program’s accreditation reflects UMPI’s commitment to preparing students for successful careers in these fields.
L35: #### Explore UMPI’s Campus and Learn More About Our Accreditations
L36: 
L37: Whether you’re exploring colleges in the US or interested in a UMPI campus tour, we invite you to experience our campus firsthand. Plan a 【7†campus tour】 and discover why students choose UMPI for its accredited programs and vibrant learning environment.
L38: 
L39: For more details about UMPI’s accreditations, visit our 【8†NECHE Accreditation page】.
